items.creator: Monja Šebela / Sentinel Hub
items.required_attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2021], processed by Sentinel Hub. Image author: Monja Šebela.
items.caption: Jalaput Reservoir in a processed Sentinel-2 view from 16 December 2021. Enhanced colours do not show the water’s natural appearance.
items.changes_required: Official 1280px Commons rendition downloaded; preserve full frame and Copernicus/Sentinel Hub mark. Ulyssys-script processing is part of the source image. Record any local resize or format conversion.
items.evidence: Commons exact reservoir location, source Flickr verification and CC BY2.0/Copernicus terms inspected. NASA ISS alternatives listed but pages inaccessible via web tool; not verified.
items.visual_review: Accepted with explicit processing caption: branching reservoir is visible in turquoise, white and yellow enhanced colours among surrounding hills. Copernicus/Sentinel Hub mark is visible at lower left and must remain. No legend is present. Image is suitable for showing reservoir shape, not natural water colour, measured water quality or current extent.
items.alt: Processed Sentinel-2 view of the branching Jalaput Reservoir, with enhanced turquoise, white and yellow water colours.

items.commons_file: File:Naturalis Biodiversity Center - ZMA.MOLL.356504 - Turbinella pyrum (Linnaeus, 1758) - Turbinellidae - Mollusc shell.jpeg
items.creator: Naturalis Biodiversity Center
items.caption: A museum specimen of Turbinella pyrum, the conch species discussed in the shell-working study; this is not an excavated object from Manikapatana.
items.changes_required: Preserve specimen and collection labels in full frame; record any resize or conversion. No scale is visible in this image.
items.evidence: Commons museum catalogue ZMA.MOLL.356504, source institution and CC0 donation verified. Exact species matches article; no local provenance claimed.
items.visual_review: Accepted as contextual species illustration: conch with historical collection labels, including Ceylon, on a black background. Not an archaeological find from Odisha. Keep all labels in full frame; no scale is visible.
items.alt: A Turbinella pyrum conch specimen beside historical museum labels on a black background.

items.reason: No confirmed openly licensed photograph of Pati Sonapur beach located in bounded Commons and web searches. Similar-name Commons results refer to Assam, Subarnapur or Mumbai; rejected. Odisha Tourism imagery lacks a verified open licence.
items.proposal: Original schematic illustration of river-mouth coast and beach-management functions, explicitly illustrative and not a surveyed map. Base geography only on article source Odisha Tourism; avoid exact shoreline or unverified facility placement.

items.reason: No usable openly licensed exact-location image found under Galigabdar/Galigabadar/Galligabdar variants. News photographs are not cleared.
items.proposal: Original illustration of stepped water over rock, explicitly conceptual rather than depiction of exact falls; alternatively explanatory visual of visitor safety and village water decisions, keeping Nuagaon stream distinct from waterfall stream.

items.reason: No openly licensed property photograph confirmed. Operator and travel-report images are copyrighted without verified reuse terms.
items.proposal: Original material study of terracotta tile, earthen wall, bamboo and ironwork; caption as illustration of materials discussed, not reconstruction of property layout.

items.reason: Commons kakara photographs cover rice/semolina/wheat or Puri/Tangi forms; no confirmed Chhatia chhena-kakara image. Do not mislabel a generic kakara picture as the local sweet.
items.proposal: Original illustration of chhena kakara and roadside trade based on original written source; avoid exact shop, recipe cross-section or specific vendor portrayal.

limitations: Jalaput is processed satellite imagery; caption must disclose enhanced colours and must not infer water quality or present-day extent.
Shell specimen is contextual species illustration with historical Ceylon labels, not an Odisha archaeological object.
Four photographic gaps reflect bounded searches, not proof that no licensed photograph exists. Parent handles original explanatory illustrations.
Downloaded files are research staging assets only; no canonical assets or content changed.
download_note: Seven exact observed asset URLs downloaded successfully. Initial last-four HTTP429 failures preserved in download_attempts and download-results.json; later spaced retries succeeded. Source snapshots contain web-reader responses, not raw HTML. No API metadata was obtained because API requests returned HTTP429.
